evidence: As identidades do Brasil (62), História & Teoria (35), Escola dos Annales (22), A história, entre a filosofia e a ciência (22), and Tempo, história e evasão (13) are by José Carlos Reis. José de Oliveira Reis wrote O Rio de Janeiro e seus prefeitos (9); it accounts for only 9 of 222 summed citing-thesis counts across the listed works (about 4%).

The sole listed work, Dictionnaire étymologique de la langue latine (all 6 citing theses), is by Alfred Ernout and Antoine Meillet, as confirmed by its publisher. “MEILLET, Alfred” is a mistaken expansion of Meillet’s given name, apparently borrowed from his coauthor.
